parsed.summary: The PR changes the default SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY to 'same-origin', which may introduce a behavioral regression risk for applications that rely on the Referer header.

issues.description: Changing the default SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY to 'same-origin' may break existing applications that depend on the Referer header for verification or analytics. This is a significant behavioral regression risk.
